note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials from learn_post_authoring. Reuse across daily runs.

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Each block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222 and data-color #FFFFFF, padding 20. Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners. Story sections use h2 headings (Models & Research, Industry & Business). Sign-off + Share button at the end. Sponsor slots use advertisementOpportunity nodes labeled 'A word from our sponsor' only when offers/agreements exist.

ad_placement_learnings.note: A post accepts only ONE 'primary' (with-logo) ad slot; additional ads must be 'secondary'. list_ad_offers ids are NUMERIC and ROTATE (a new batch is issued roughly each run) — always fetch fresh ids immediately before placing. Robust pattern: save_post with NO ad nodes first (always succeeds), then add ads one at a time via edit_post_content using current offer ids; this isolates any slot/cap failure so one bad ad can't kill the whole draft.
ad_placement_learnings.layout_used_2026-08-08: 1 primary top (after intro) + 2 secondary bottom (before sign-off), matching the established daily format.
